title: 从 DeepSeek Super-agent 看 Agent 的下一步
title_en: What DeepSeek’s Super-agent says about where agents go next
summary: DeepSeek 近期公开了 Super-agent 的设计文章与研究原型。本文结合我在长任务与 Agent 平台方面的实践，分析这套设计的价值、尚待解决的问题，以及社区讨论中的主要分歧。
summary_en: DeepSeek recently published its Super-agent design and a research prototype. Drawing on my work on long-running tasks and agent platforms, this note examines what the design offers, what remains unresolved, and where the community disagrees.
